name: I Am Janitor
summary:
**Welcome to the night shift!**   
I Am Janitor puts you in the shoes of a nightclub janitor in an interactive VR sandbox. Clean up wild parties, tackle gross messes, and earn cash. When the boss isn’t looking, use "unconventional" equipment to turn the club into your playground!

**🧹 Play as a Janitor**  
Experience the nightlife from a new perspective. Scrub floors, scrape gum, clear trash, and fix VIP disasters and overflowing toilets.
